house_style: Warm storybook gouache and colored-pencil illustration for a K-2 school art museum. Rich tactile materials, warm honey wood, pale sage and cream, gentle light from upper left. Clean confident silhouettes, playful handmade irregularities, carefully observed small details. No people, human faces or body parts. No text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks.

assets.prompt: A clean empty elementary school hallway wall seen straight on, pale sage painted wall, a single tall window centered in the middle fifth, shiny linoleum floor along the bottom fifth, soft daylight from the window falling left, bare wall across the full width.
